people.name: Ephesus
people.line: Major city in Asia Minor; important center for early Christianity

people.name: Macedonia
people.line: A region in northern Greece; Paul preached there

translations.web: As I urged you when I was going into Macedonia, stay at Ephesus that you might command certain men not to teach a different doctrine,
translations.bsb: As I urged you on my departure to Macedonia, you should stay on at Ephesus to instruct certain men not to teach false doctrines
translations.kjv: As I besought thee to abide still at Ephesus, when I went into Macedonia, that thou mightest charge some that they teach ➔ no other doctrine,
translations.asv: As I exhorted thee to tarry at Ephesus, when I was going into Macedonia, that thou mightest charge certain men not to teach a different doctrine,
